usernames.title: Profiles
usernames.description: Threads usernames or profile URLs, e.g. zuck, @mosseri, https://www.threads.com/@nasa.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Threads post URLs to read with their replies, e.g. https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/DeZtp-TkQHh.

includeProfile.title: Include profile rows
includeProfile.description: One row per profile with bio, followers, verified badge, bio links and picture.

maxPostsPerProfile.title: Max posts per profile
maxPostsPerProfile.description: Logged-out Threads shows a profile's latest ~10-20 posts.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Replies under post URLs, and the profile's own replies.
